name: MonarchInlineEditText
title: InlineEditText
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField (through MonarchTextField) and androidx.compose.material3.Button (through MonarchButton), switched in place from androidx.compose.material3.Text
summary: Text that turns into a field in place, with an asynchronous save, a saving state and an error that keeps the editor open.
whenToUse: For renaming or correcting one value where it is shown: a document title, a name in a header, a note on a detail screen.
whenNotToUse: For a form of several fields that are saved together use MonarchTextField with a save button. For text that is edited all the time use a field that is always shown.
api: @Composable fun MonarchInlineEditText(value: String, onSave: suspend (String) -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, placeholder: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, multiline: Boolean = false, startEditing: Boolean = false, trim: Boolean = true, saveOnFocusLoss: Boolean = true, validate: ((String) -> String?)? = null, errorMessage: ((Throwable) -> String?)? = null, onCancel: (() -> Unit)? = null, onEditingChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, editIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchInlineEditTextLabels = MonarchInlineEditTextLabels())
class MonarchInlineEditTextLabels(editHint: String? = null, save: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, saving: String? = null, saveFailed: String? = null)

options.name: onSave
options.description: Saves the new text and updates value. Throw to keep the editor open with the error and the draft. Not called when the trimmed text is unchanged.

options.name: label
options.description: What the text is, for example "Title": the field's label, and the spoken name in view mode.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in view mode while the value is empty, and as the field's placeholder.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error from the app, such as an edit conflict, shown while editing.

options.name: enabled
options.description: When false the value is plain text in the disabled color and cannot be edited.

options.name: multiline
options.description: A field of several lines: Enter adds a line, Save or Ctrl or Cmd with Enter saves.

options.name: startEditing
options.description: Opens the editor when the component first appears.

options.name: trim
options.description: Trims the text before comparing and saving.

options.name: saveOnFocusLoss
options.description: Saves when focus leaves the field.

options.name: validate
options.description: Returns a message to refuse the text before saving.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Turns a failed save into a message. By default the exception's message, or "Couldn't save. Try again."

options.name: onCancel
options.description: Called when the user cancels with the button or Escape.

options.name: onEditingChange
options.description: Called when the editor opens or closes.

options.name: editIcon
options.description: An icon after the text in view mode, such as a pencil. Decoration; Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Edit", "Save", "Cancel", "Saving" and "Couldn't save. Try again."

states.name: viewing
states.description: The value in the default text color, or the placeholder in the subtle color, with the optional icon.

states.name: editing
states.description: A MonarchTextField with the focus ring color, and Save (primary) and Cancel (ghost) buttons under it.

states.name: saving
states.description: The field is disabled, Save shows progress with the state "Saving" and Cancel is disabled.

states.name: error
states.description: The field's danger outline and the message under it. The draft is kept.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Plain text in the disabled color that cannot be edited.

appearance: In view mode the text uses the body style in the default text color, the subtle color for the placeholder and the disabled color when disabled; the icon is muted. In edit mode it is MonarchTextField with small MonarchButtons. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: On the web, Enter saves and Escape cancels and the buttons are optional for one line. A touch keyboard has no Escape key, so, as on iOS, Save and Cancel are always shown; Done saves one line and a hardware Escape still cancels. The web shows a spinner inside the field; here the Save button shows the progress. The saved value is hoisted: onSave stores it and the app passes the new value, in place of the web's controlled and uncontrolled value. The web's controlled editing state is reduced to startEditing with an onEditingChange callback, and onSaveError is the exception thrown by onSave, which the app can catch in its own code. The web's rows and maxLength are not offered; a multi-line field grows with its text. The system back gesture does not cancel; it is left to the screen.
accessibility: In view mode it is one button: the label as its name, the value (or the placeholder) as its state, and "Edit" as the action TalkBack announces.
In edit mode the field has the same label and takes focus; an error is the field's error, shown as text and a danger outline, not color alone.
While saving, the Save button's state is "Saving" and the field and Cancel are disabled.
The text in view mode and the buttons are at least 48dp high; text scales with the font size setting.
The icon is hidden from TalkBack.
edgeCases: Leaving the field to tap Save or Cancel does not save twice: a save that is running ignores further requests.
A save that fails gives focus back to the field.
With trim, a value that only gained spaces is unchanged and closes without saving.
Disabling the component while it is editing shows the value as plain text; the draft is kept for when it is enabled again.

examples.title: Title with validation
examples.template:
MonarchInlineEditText(
    value = title,
    onSave = { newTitle ->
        delay(600)
        title = newTitle
    },
    label = {{label}},
    validate = { if (it.isEmpty()) {{emptyError}} else null },
)
examples.setup: var title by remember { mutableStateOf("Update onboarding checklist") }
examples.code:
MonarchInlineEditText(
    value = title,
    onSave = { newTitle ->
        delay(600)
        title = newTitle
    },
    label = "Title",
    validate = { if (it.isEmpty()) "Enter a title." else null },
)

examples.title: Validation
examples.code:
MonarchInlineEditText(
    value = name,
    onSave = { name = it },
    label = "Name",
    validate = { if (it.isEmpty()) "Enter a name." else null },
)

examples.title: Several lines, open for a new item
examples.code:
MonarchInlineEditText(
    value = notes,
    onSave = { notes = it },
    label = "Notes",
    placeholder = "Add notes",
    multiline = true,
    startEditing = true,
)
